downsample: OpenCV INTER_AREA, exact native decoded RGB source
source_point_correspondence: seed once on native center; exact pixel-center map (xy+0.5)/3-0.5 for OpenCV INTER_AREA downsample; never redetect for source arm

points.split: lexically sorted fixed IDs, even fit odd held; no visibility-dependent reassignment

insufficient_seed_policy: record failed center without inventing duplicate/grid points; no replacement center

learned.preprocessing: upstream bilinear align_corners=True at pinned model resolution, frame-wise memory bound
learned.reverse_cycle: eight independent endpoint queries on reversed dense video, observe returned center; never coordinate inversion

pairlocal_definition: same fixed center query IDs, each center-to-endpoint LK pair independent; all 61 decoded frames provided, no propagation across pairs. This controlled pair-local baseline is not identical to old per-pair redetection.

geometry.similarity: deterministic least squares, fixed fit IDs only

real_reference: pair_local_center_endpoint held observations, shared by all fitted-motion predictions; not independent physical ground truth
common_support: intersection across ALL three reference visibility and three prediction masks, same held IDs and noncenter timestamps; missing pairs separately; never improve by own-target preference
direct_coordinate_tests: fixed-seed known camera/root/same-opposite translation/orthogonal nonrigid articulation; <=1e-6 normalized recovery, identity permutation and known-distinct wrong actor >=25% penalty with 0.005 floor

synthetic_image_controls.negative_control: rigid-only tracks on nonrigid fixture must fail known-truth relative articulation recovery

phase_authorization: Require primary summary status CROSSING_EVENT_COMPLETE_NO_GO, promotion_passed false, 45 fits, matching independent audit and execution lock hashes, 45 replay PASS, audit-pinned input/output hashes. Numerical abort does not authorize inference.
scope_limit: 16 centers only. No expansion flag, label access, task model, correction router, hyperparameter sweep, automatic retry or CPU fallback.
synthetic_support: At least75% all-time visibility separately for actor and background; at least75% each fixed expected256 held-noncenter pairs for actor/camera/root/articulation. If truth has root-motion amplitude>0.05diagonal, >=75% of those fixed expected pairs must support relative-error gate; missing all is failure, not inapplicability.
expanded_128_separate_protocol: Only after smoke pass; repaired held consistency >=20% over pair-local and positive>=4/5 folds, show LK and reference sensitivity; never promote on own-target fit.

runtime_limits.on_cuda_oom: stop and record invalid_runtime; no dynamic resize/chunk policy change
